baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative بأي governs plural آلاء, while ربكما and تكذبان address two recipients under one Lord.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bestowed favor is placed under the Lord's authority and made the object of a dual act of declaring false, so the question tests shared recognition rather than requesting information.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply the plural objects placed under interrogation.
Lordship, ownership, and authority locate the favors and both addressees within one governing relation.
Declaring a thing or report false makes the dual response an active rejection of what is presented.

changed_reading.before: An uncontextualized question about unspecified things.
changed_reading.after: Which of your shared Lord's bestowed favors will you two actively declare false?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct ربكما binds nurture to the two recipients, and the causative تكذبان can test whether that relation proves true in their response.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rabb as repair, nurture, and completion turns favor from a transferred object into formative care; the branch of a charge proving true or failing lets denial occur in conduct as well as speech.

activation_trace.role: Favor provides the received good whose formative effect is at issue.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the Lord-recipient relation an ongoing process of formation.
A charge proves true by being carried through and false by failing, supplying the behavioral test.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a verbal opinion about a gift.
changed_reading.after: The two recipients can falsify nurturing favor by failing to carry its formative charge to completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy opens a sequence of teaching and disclosed meaning, so the recurring interrogative can function as pedagogical elicitation: the taught recipients must articulate recognition of what has been made manifest.

activation_trace.role: Mercy and tenderness set the affective frame in which the later challenge is delivered.
A thing becoming uncovered to a knower makes teaching a transfer into recognition.
Disclosing meaning through speech or sign supplies the recipients' capacity to answer the question.
The focus verb turns the elicited answer into a choice either to recognize or to declare the lesson false.

structural_cues: 55:1-4 moves from mercy to teaching, creating the human, and teaching articulation before the first refrain.
The focus retains an interrogative object and dual verbal morphology rather than supplying a declarative answer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, teaching, disclosure, and a later repeated question; I infer a lesson-to-response arrow, while a purely forensic accusation remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The refrain only accuses two hearers of disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The merciful teacher repeatedly elicits from two taught speakers whether they will voice recognition or negate the disclosed lesson.

context_deltas.mechanism: The balance sequence gives denial an operational test: a favor is acknowledged truthfully when recipients establish just measure, and it is made false in practice when they diminish what is due.

activation_trace.role: The balance of justice provides the norm against which a response can be tested.
Justice and equity specify that truthful weighing is relationally fair.
Shortchanging measure supplies the concrete action by which reception becomes deficient.
The failed charge connects falsehood to conduct that does not carry through.

structural_cues: 55:7-9 places the balance, prohibits excess in it, and commands weight with equity and without deficit.
The refrain later evaluates the recipients repeatedly rather than isolating belief from action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a just scale, a prohibition of deficit, and the focus branch of a failed charge; I extend measurement from the explicit social act to reception of favor, though the scale may remain only cosmic and commercial.

changed_reading.before: To deny a favor is to reject a proposition about it.
changed_reading.after: To deny a favor is also to under-realize it: the two make the gift false in the world when their measure is unjust or deficient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory's capacity branch is sharpened by the failed attempt to cross cosmic bounds except through authority: ability itself becomes one of the Lord's grants, and denial can masquerade as a claim of autonomous power.

activation_trace.role: The ability branch lets آلاء activate not only possessed goods but capacities to act.
Passing cleanly to the other side supplies the concrete capacity attempted, commanded, and negated.
Power and delegated authority condition passage, making effective capacity non-autonomous.
Lordship locates authorization with the giver rather than with the two agents alone.

structural_cues: 55:33 repeats penetrate in command, negation, and conditional form and makes passage depend on سلطان.
The same verse directly addresses the paired communities before another refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted passage, inability, and conditioning authority; I infer that contingent capacity is itself favor, while سلطان could alternatively mean evidentiary warrant rather than granted power.

changed_reading.before: The favors are external objects that the two may deny.
changed_reading.after: Which granted capacities and permissions of your Lord will you two misdescribe as powers belonging to you independently?

context_deltas.mechanism: Dynamic contact is held together with an interval and non-transgression, after which hidden value emerges; the dual address can therefore be heard as joint accountability for a relation whose fruit depends on distinction without rupture.

activation_trace.role: Mixing and disturbance supply the energetic contact between the paired seas.
The interval between two things supplies a maintained middle rather than total fusion.
Overstepping a limit through aggression names the failure that the boundary prevents.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the valuable yield of constrained contact.
The charge that succeeds or fails turns the paired relation into something the two must carry through.

structural_cues: 55:19-22 orders two seas, their meeting, an intervening barrier, non-transgression, and an emergent yield.
The focus marks both the Lord relation and the act of denial with dual suffixes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contact, interval, prohibited overreach, and subsequent emergence; I infer a productive-boundary arrow and apply it to the dual addressees, while the sequence may instead remain only a maritime sign.

changed_reading.before: The dual ending merely counts two independent hearers.
changed_reading.after: The two are tested together: will they falsify the favor by collapsing, transgressing, or refusing the bounded relation through which value emerges?

context_deltas.mechanism: Refrains punctuate both universal passing and unmistakable judgment, expanding آلاء beyond pleasant provision: limits, exposure, and advance warning can be beneficent disclosures even when the disclosed consequence is severe.

activation_trace.role: The favors branch is the category whose contextual range is widened beyond delights.
Cessation and departure after persistence make finitude itself an explicit disclosure.
Endurance and remaining establish the contrast by which transient things are truthfully classified.
Recognition through a visible trace makes judgment an exposure that no longer depends on verbal confession.
Being taken to account for wrongdoing supplies the severe consequence distinguished from the warning that reveals it.

structural_cues: The refrain follows the mortality-permanence contrast at 55:28 and recurs throughout 55:31-45 among constraint, exposure, seizure, and punishment.
The same wording also punctuates the later garden descriptions, forcing one category across unlike affects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies identical refrains after both delights and severe disclosures; I infer that warning and truthful limitation can count as favor, not that suffering as such is pleasant, while the refrain may alternatively point back to general favors rather than each adjacent scene.

changed_reading.after: Which merciful disclosures will you deny, including the exposure of finitude, limits, and consequences that prevents false confidence?

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirrored relation of beautiful action and beautiful return gives favor a response circuit; truthful reception is enacted as ihsan, while denial is a break in reciprocity.

activation_trace.role: Meeting an act with its recompense supplies the directional return from received good to answering good.
Beautiful doing appears on both sides of the relation, making response qualitative rather than merely verbal.
Nurture and completion make the return a maturation of what was received.
A charge failing to carry through models denial as interrupted reciprocity.

structural_cues: 55:60 repeats إحسان on both sides of إلا, then the refrain resumes at 55:61.
The focus arrives after further gifts but retains an active second-person dual verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies action answered by recompense and repeats ihsan across that relation; I infer that the recipients' truthful answer should also take enacted form, while 55:60 may refer only to divine recompense for prior human action.

changed_reading.before: Acknowledgment ends when the recipients admit that a favor exists.
changed_reading.after: Acknowledgment completes a circuit: received ihsan calls forth ihsan, and denial is the failure to return the gift as beautiful action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden passage repeatedly nests pairs within pairs, so the focus dual is not incidental counting: two recipients are asked to recognize a differentiated but jointly held ecology of provision.

activation_trace.role: A garden sheltered by dense growth supplies the first paired habitat of provision.
A source of running water supplies a paired flow sustaining the habitat.
A counterpart joined to its mate makes pairing the explicit organization of each fruit.
One Lord's authority holds the paired recipients and provisions within a common source.

structural_cues: Dual gardens, dual springs, paired fruit, another dual gardens, and another dual springs recur through 55:46-68.
The refrain's possessive and verb remain dual at every occurrence, including the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nested dual forms in habitat, flow, fruit, and address; I infer a formal ecology of shared comparison, while the duals may simply enumerate provisions and audiences independently.

changed_reading.before: Each recipient privately inventories isolated gifts.
changed_reading.after: The two are made co-witnesses to patterned, paired abundance and must answer for recognition of the whole relation, not just preferred items.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, limitation and dwelling form a protected interior; the question can interrupt acquisitive reception and test whether the recipients acknowledge the Lord's boundaries as part of the favor.

activation_trace.role: Restriction and being held to a domain supply the local image of bounded access.
Tent and settled dwelling make that bounded domain an inhabited interior rather than an abstract limit.
Lordship prevents the recipients from treating the protected scene as unqualified possession.
The behavioral charge lets violation of a limit falsify the claimed recognition of favor.

structural_cues: 55:72 immediately precedes the focus and joins a restricted participle to tents.
55:74 follows with an untouched-before relation; ط م ث is listed under missing_branch_inventories and is used here only as a structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, dwelling, and the untouched sequel; I infer that protection and inviolacy constitute the favor and regulate reception, while the imagery may instead denote residence and beauty without that ethical arrow.

changed_reading.before: The refrain merely endorses the preceding scene as consumable luxury.
changed_reading.after: The refrain asks whether the two will honor the protected limits of the Lord's gift; favor includes inviolacy, not only enjoyment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier contrast between passing and remaining and the final image of stable, growing good frame particular favors as transient manifestations of an enduring generativity grounded in the Lord.

activation_trace.role: Endurance and remaining distinguish the stable source from passing manifestations.
Stable, growing good supplies the final mode by which favor continues and increases.
Staying, clinging, and lasting activate persistence within the focus designation of Lord.
Bestowed favors are recast as instances of durable, generative good rather than isolated consumables.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 opposes the passing of all upon the earth to what remains.
After the focus and two more refrains, 55:78 closes by returning to the name of the Lord and stable blessing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a passing/remaining contrast and a final stable-growing good; I infer that these frame the ontology of آلاء, while the closing blessing may praise the name without redefining each prior favor.

changed_reading.before: A favor is an episodic benefit exhausted in consumption.
changed_reading.after: Which manifestations of your Lord's abiding, self-renewing good will you deny merely because each manifestation changes or passes?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the non-dominant ت ل و mapping of focus ء ل و, so it is surprising and must not replace the lexical favors reading. It remains anchored in the mapped focus inventory and the exact chain of refrains; downstream prose should present it as an antiphonal sound-and-sequence activation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus آلاء has a split mapped inventory, and 55:73 is one link in an exact recurring dual-address refrain.

activation_trace.role: A voice following another voice supplies an antiphonal image for a refrain that solicits response.
The preceding identical refrain makes the focus voice follow a prior interrogative voice after one intervening scene.
The next identical refrain makes the focus itself a voice to be followed in the continuing sequence.

changed_reading.before: The refrain merely repeats a proposition.
changed_reading.after: The focus is an antiphonal cue: one voice follows another while calling for the two recipients' answering voice.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The liability image comes from the non-dominant ت ل و mapping and a root-distant covenant branch, so آلاء should not be translated as debt. The reading remains worth carrying because possessive ربكما, dual response, and the recompense sequence make obligation relationally visible; render it only as an ethical afterimage of favor.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins favor, the two recipients' Lord, and their active response in one compact possessive construction.

activation_trace.role: A right or liability that follows its holder supplies the image of obligation continuing after receipt.
A covenant or binding pact gives the continuing claim a relational bond.
A charge made false by failure supplies the breach through which the obligation is denied.
Seeking and receiving what is due on a debt sharpens, without lexicalizing, the image of a return still owed.

changed_reading.before: A favor ends at the moment it is received.
changed_reading.after: Each favor leaves an answering claim that follows its recipients, and denial is failure to discharge that response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The running-then-stopping image is an idiomatic, branch-distant use of ك ذ ب and cannot be asserted as the focus verb's lexical sense. It remains structurally anchored because each identical verb occurs at a segment boundary; render the reading with 'as if' language as a discourse analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus تكذبان occupies a repeated caesura immediately after 55:72 and before the discourse resumes at 55:74.

activation_trace.role: Running a stage, stopping, and looking behind supplies a discourse image for retrospective inspection at the focus.
The previous refrain demonstrates the same stop-and-look-back placement after a completed descriptive unit.
The following refrain repeats the retrospective pause after the next unit, confirming the local rhythm.

changed_reading.before: The refrain only halts the forward catalogue.
changed_reading.after: The refrain behaves as if it stops the running discourse and turns both recipients back to inspect what the preceding scene has made visible.

strongest_changes: Denial shifts from verbal rejection to enacted failure under the packet's measures of justice, completion, and reciprocal ihsan.
آلاء expands from pleasant benefits to capacity, truthful limitation, warning, exposure, and enduring generativity.
The local enclosure and the surah's paired ecology make reception relational and bounded rather than merely acquisitive.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is both a local threshold after protected dwelling and one pulse in a surah-wide dual refrain. That placement activated coexisting pedagogical, ethical, spatial, temporal, and antiphonal readings, while split mappings exposed capacity, following, and attached-obligation afterimages that a conservative reading would suppress.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant ت ل و activations may be only structural analogies rather than live lexical resonances of آلاء.
The severe passages may make warning and disclosure favors without classifying the painful consequences themselves as favors.
The local قصر, خيام, and branchless ط م ث sequence may signal protected inviolacy, or may only describe residence, exclusivity, and prior untouchedness.
The repeated dual patterns do not force a single relation between the two addressees and the paired garden imagery.
